description: Floor plans for the advert. Mirrors images-schema: the three keys knowable when the advert is collected are required, and everything a CDN adds later is optional. Which CDN generation processed an entry is given by `cdn` — 2 is the legacy Cloudinary path (cloudinary_account / public_id / version), 3 and 4 are Bunny (path). See the changelog for why v1.1.0 could not express this.

title_fr.description: Not currently populated for floor plans. Present so they can adopt the same bilingual treatment as images without another version bump.

original_url.description: The URL the floor plan was collected from. Required — an entry that names no source cannot be fetched or re-fetched — but nullable, because an archived entry may no longer have one.

cdn.description: Which CDN generation holds this file. 2 = Cloudinary (legacy), 3 and 4 = Bunny. Absent until the file has been processed.

path.description: Bunny path, appended to the CDN's base_uri to build a URL (cdn 3 and 4).

cloudinary_account.description: Legacy, cdn 2 only. Retained because IFP\Basebox\AdvertImage\Cdn2AdvertImage still reads it.
